# T4 Service

Status: Draft for product-owner review (b10-design §7.2 item 1). Not delivered at any venue.

- Audience: Front-of-house staff
- Runs it: VM
- Length: 15 minutes in the shift ([walkthrough](README.md#walkthrough))
- Practical task: Report a change to one current answer.

## Covers

- Arrival, entrance, toilets and Wi-Fi questions
- Covering the Wi-Fi password and join QR code before any photo
- Reporting a change to a current answer

## Read with

- [Amenity checks](../../usage-staff.md#amenity-checks)
- [Add photos from any page](../../usage-staff.md#add-photos-from-any-page)

## What the app says

- Couldn't establish: You tried and couldn't find out.
- For guest Wi-Fi, cover the Wi-Fi password and the join QR code before you take any photo or video, then tick I have covered the Wi-Fi password and join QR code.
